classificationFinding.observed: All 41 items are assigned to the stored standard VAT row. This is a coherent numeric configuration, not product-specific evidence that every assignment is applicable. Item and TaxRate expose rate references/names/type/activation but no exemption reason, product classification, effective classification version or approval evidence. No such classification was resolved in the inspected POS consumer.
classificationFinding.ownerRoleProposed: Tax/accounting owner supplies the classification matrix; inventory/catalog owner supplies product specifications; engineering implements evidence-backed mapping and tests.
classificationFinding.localSyntheticEngineeringWork: Create a documented synthetic classification matrix and development scenarios with explicit provenance. Exercise applicable positive-rate and zero-rate scenarios only as test assumptions. Add validation/provenance support where needed; retain current data until an authorized correction is designed.
realProductionInputRequired: For each extracted item: product composition/processing and packaging, relevant transaction/jurisdiction context, and sale date/effective period.
Applicable entity registration/tax regime confirmed by its authorized accounting owner.
Reviewed product-tax treatment, official source/reference and effective dates, including reason/evidence for any special or zero treatment.
classificationFinding.stageEffect: Blocks claiming product-specific tax accuracy or production fiscal readiness. No dedicated product-classification enforcement gate was found in the inspected item/POS paths; engineering development can proceed with explicitly synthetic assumptions. Do not change rates from product names alone.

zeroRateMeaning.observed: Two active rows are named Zero-rated VAT and have no assigned items. Their numeric zero is meaningful for a test scenario, but it is not a documented exemption classification. The POS fiscal builder emits taxCode=null whenever the rate is zero, so reason-specific zero treatment is not represented there.
zeroRateMeaning.engineeringWork: Preserve distinct tax treatment/reason evidence through the item/line/fiscal contract when real zero or special treatment is supported; test that it is not inferred solely from a numeric zero.
zeroRateMeaning.productionInput: An authorized tax owner must identify the applicable treatment and source evidence before assigning either row to real products.

unitsMeaningfulness.observed: Active units have concrete names, dimensions and positive conversion factors: piece/bottle/can/tube, kilogram/litre, one-kilogram detergent bag, six-bottle pack, sheet and 500-sheet ream. Unassigned Sheet rows are meaningful bases for the ream conversions. Two generic Pack rows are inactive and unused. All assigned references are active; this is a catalog-semantic assessment, not proof that every conversion workflow was exercised.
unitsMeaningfulness.neededInput: Confirm whether Orange juice 1 L and Mango nectar 1 L are stocked/sold by measured litre or by sealed one-litre package. Their names alone do not decide this. If packages, design a unit conversion and quantity-preserving migration rather than merely changing the unit label.
unitsMeaningfulness.localEngineeringWork: Document the intended synthetic stocking unit and add appropriate conversion/quantity tests. No external legal review is required for this business-unit choice.

limitations: No tax authority sources were independently reviewed in this task; stored names and source-code country parameters are not legal certification.
No database writes, application edits, tax reassignments or production approvals occurred.
All affected IDs are supplied in this report; the user need not rediscover them.
